message.content: The scheduler admits requests only when their KV cache bookings fit within the device budget, while parked sessions retain their prefix entries to optimize future processing. When a subsequent turn extends the same prompt, the system restores the retained prefix entry and primes only the new suffix rather than recomputing the entire context. All forty notes consistently emphasize that the core verification task is determining whether this restored state is byte-identical to a cold prime of the whole prompt.
